description: Upcoming unlocks where the calendar source and the project's own documents disagree: a different amount on the same date (amount_differs) or a different date (date_differs). Each row puts the two versions side by side (calendar vs documents: date, share of total supply, share of circulating supply, strength by each version) with links to the documents. Use for 'which unlocks are disputed', 'is this unlock size real', 'why do sites show different numbers for X', and before quoting a very large percentage from the calendar. Only unlocks we have checked against documents can appear (checked_against_documents says how many were checked); an unlock missing here is unchecked or matching, not confirmed. The document figures are our own reading of primary sources and can be wrong. token narrows the list to one coin (exact ticker, slug or name). For all upcoming unlocks use get_upcoming_unlocks; for on-chain movements of locked wallets use get_onchain_check.

token.description: Optional: one token (ticker, slug or name, exact).

name: get_disputed_unlocks
